source.name: 12dicts
source.rights: The compiler explicitly released 12dicts to the public domain and requests acknowledgment. The 2of12inf and 2+2+3 lists have separate antecedent terms; DoPop uses neither.

normalization: Keep only unannotated ASCII alphabetic entries of 3 to 7 letters from International/3of6game.txt; uppercase, deduplicate, and sort alphabetically.
word_search_grid_seed: wordRng(3907 + puzzleIndex * 97), using the versioned deterministic xorshift32 helper

word_levels.rack_source: Distinct 4 to 7 letter racks from the normalized lexicon that can form at least six words.
word_levels.rack_order: Group by rack length in counts 100/300/350/250 for lengths 4/5/6/7; rank rack signatures by SHA-256 of dopop-words-v2:<sorted-rack>.
word_levels.targets: Generated deterministically from the rack and lexicon; target count rises from 3 to 6 in four 250-level bands.
